title: Bug: test_cpu_shaper.py failed with AssertionError: CPU queue shaper missing for cos queues {0, 7} before reboot. Got: {}
author: wrideout-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Test fails as cos queue information is missing at the time of assertion.  On full-scale topologies the test is flaky as the assertion fires before all cos queues are ready.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test cpu_shaper/test_cpu_shaper.py on full-scale topology testbed.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should assert on converged state once all cos queues are ready.

### Relevant log output

```shell
"filename": "cpu_shaper/test_cpu_shaper.py",
"message": "AssertionError: CPU queue shaper missing for cos queues {0, 7} before reboot. Got: {}",
"messagetext": "duthosts = [<MultiAsicSonicHost qsd209>]\nlocalhost = <tests.common.devices.local.Localhost object at 0x7f927fbd7b60>\nenum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'qsd209'\nrequest = <FixtureRequest for <Function test_cpu_queue_shaper[qsd209]>>\n\n    @pytest.mark.disable_loganalyzer\n    def test_cpu_queue_shaper(duthosts, localhost, enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname, request):\n        \"\"\"\n        Validates the cpu queue shaper configuration survives reboot by comparing\n        shaper values before and after reboot.\n        \"\"\"\n        duthost = duthosts[enum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname]\n        try:\n            reboot_type = request.config.getoption(\"--cpu_shaper_reboot_type\")\n            # Read shaper config before reboot\n            before_pps = get_cpu_queue_shaper(duthost)\n            logger.info(\"CPU queue shaper before reboot: {}\".format(before_pps))\n    \n            # Validate all expected queues are present with non-zero shaper values\n            missing = EXPECTED_COS_QUEUES - set(before_pps.keys())\n>           assert not missing, \\\n                   ^^^^^^^^^^^\n                \"CPU queue shaper missing for cos queues {} before reboot. Got: {}\".format(missing, before_pps)\nE               AssertionError: CPU queue shaper missing for cos queues {0, 7} before reboot. Got: {}\n\nbefore_pps = {}\nduthost    = <MultiAsicSonicHost qsd209>\nduthosts   = [<MultiAsicSonicHost qsd209>]\nenum_rand_one_per_hwsku_frontend_hostname = 'qsd209'\nlocalhost  = <tests.common.devices.local.Localhost object at 0x7f927fbd7b60>\nmissing    = {0, 7}\nreboot_type = 'cold'\nrequest    = <FixtureRequest for <Function test_cpu_queue_shaper[qsd209]>>\n\ncpu_shaper/test_cpu_shaper.py:71: AssertionError",
"start": "2026-05-13 22:19:06.686736",
"status": "failure",
"testname": "test_cpu_queue_shaper[qsd209]",
```

linkedPullRequests.title: Make sure lldp is populated after dut/service restart
linkedPullRequests.author: wrideout-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
Timing on full-topos is such that straight assertions in cpu_shaper
tests can be flaky. Use wait_until when fetching and verifying cpu
queue shapers before and after DUT reboot to get test passrate to
reflect eventual state.
